description: This is a test module written in Python for testing the 'GenericAPILogger' callback implementation in the 'litellm' project. It uses pytest and asyncio to perform unit tests on the logging callback, mocking HTTP requests and verifying payload contents.

classes.name: GenericAPILogger
classes.description: A logging callback class that sends logging data to a specified HTTP endpoint. It formats payloads and manages asynchronous HTTP POST requests.

methods.name: test_generic_api_callback()
methods.description: An asynchronous test function that verifies the behavior of the 'GenericAPILogger' callback by mocking HTTP requests and checking the payload contents after a simulated API call.

methods.name: test_generic_api_callback_multiple_logs()
methods.description: An asynchronous test function that verifies the callback's behavior when multiple log entries are generated and flushed.
